title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Fighting Fool
description: A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.

title: The Tall T
description: An outlaw (Richard Boone) and his men hold an heiress (Maureen O'Sullivan), her cowardly husband and a rancher (Randolph Scott).

title: Coroner Creek
description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.

title: Apache Ambush
description: On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.

title: The Mountain Men
description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

title: End of the Trail
description: An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

title: Alvarez Kelly
description: A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.

title: The Doolins of Oklahoma
description: Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.

title: Seminole Uprising
description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

title: One Man Law
description: Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.

title: Riders of Black River
description: A former Texas Ranger's plans to marry are complicated by his future brother-in-law's involvement with cattle rustlers.

title: Battle of Rogue River
description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

title: Santa Fe
description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

title: The Wild Westerners
description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

title: Gunman's Walk
description: A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.

title: Indian Uprising
description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

title: Return to Warbow
description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

title: Jubal
description: A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.

title: Dirty Little Billy
description: Farm boy Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) rebels in 1870s Kansas and goes on to become Billy the Kid.

title: Cripple Creek
description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

title: The Thrill Hunter
description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

title: Brave Warrior
description: Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.

title: Major Dundee
description: A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.

title: Western Code
description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Fighting Fool
description: A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.

title: The Longest Drive
description: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.

title: Apache Territory
description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

title: Riding Wild
description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

title: They Rode West
description: The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: Daring Danger
description: A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.

title: The Quick Gun
description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

title: Gunmen From Laredo
description: A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: Blazing Across the Pecos
description: The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.
